end.summary:
Named earthworm, millipede, and beetle as soil or leaf-litter animals.
Discussed ants having six legs and earthworms having no legs.
Earthworms were incorrectly grouped with insects; this was not corrected later.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying small animals found in soil and leaf litter, using examples and leg counts. Pihu named several animals and gave the correct leg counts for an ant and an earthworm. The mix-up that earthworms are insects remained at the end; at home, sort picture cards into “insect” and “not an insect,” then explain one reason for each choice.
